## Data Model Signals

### Entities Revealed
- **Person** — core entity; fields: name (first + last), phone (with status), email, address, tags, stage, source, created date, last visit date, last communication date/content, last text received date, price, assigned agent, inactive flag, updated date
- **Smart List** — saved list definition; fields: id (integer, e.g. 37), name ("All Expireds"), filters definition (array of filter criteria), column configuration (ordered list of visible columns), saved column presets/views
- **Tag** — entity applied to Person; values seen: "Expired Listing", "Import", "compliance:...", "Unsubscribed", "Expired", "wi..." (withdrawn?)
- **Stage** — enum applied to Person; values referenced: "Active Client" (excluded by filter), others not fully visible
- **Agent** — assignable person; value seen: "Matt Ryan"
- **Communication** — last communication event; has: timestamp (relative "7 months ago"), content snippet (text message body), sender name ("Matt Ryan")
- **Column Preset / Saved View** — named set of visible columns; name seen: "Out Of State Home ..."

### Enums / Field Types
- **Phone status:** good (green icon) / bad or unverified (absence of green icon) / Twilio-special (purple icon)
- **Tag system:** free-form string tags, multi-value per contact
- **Stage:** enum (Active Client, Expired Listing implied as stage or tag, others)
- **Source:** string (visible as a column, no values currently shown in viewport)
- **Smart List filter operators:** "exclude any of", "include any of", "more than", "is good", "includes any of" — implies multi-select filter values with include/exclude logic

### Relationships
- Person → many Tags
- Person → one Stage
- Person → one Agent (assigned)
- Person → many Communications (last one surfaced in list view)
- Smart List → many filter criteria
- Smart List → ordered column list + column presets

### Column Category Taxonomy (from picker)
Details (10 columns), Assigned (2), Emails (1), Calls (0+), Texts (1), Website activity (5), Deals, Inbox Apps, Custom Fields — this maps to the full column schema for the people list view

```
      {/* Columns Picker — floating popover */}
      <ColumnPickerPopover open={true}>
        <CategoryList>
          <CategoryItem label="Details" count={10} active />
          <CategoryItem label="Assigned" count={2} />
          <CategoryItem label="Emails" count={1} />
          <CategoryItem label="Calls" />
          <CategoryItem label="Texts" count={1} />
          <CategoryItem label="Website activity" count={5} />
          <CategoryItem label="Deals" />
          <CategoryItem label="Inbox Apps" />
          <CategoryItem label="Custom Fields" />
        </CategoryList>
        <ColumnToggleList>
          <ColumnToggle name="First Name" checked={false} />
          <ColumnToggle name="Last Name" checked={false} />
          <ColumnToggle name="Phone" checked={true} hasSubOption />
          <ColumnToggle name="Email" checked={true} />
          <ColumnToggle name="Address" checked={false} />
          <ColumnToggle name="Price" checked={true} />
          <ColumnToggle name="Tags" checked={true} hasSubOption />
          <ColumnToggle name="Stage" checked={true} hasSubOption />
          <ColumnToggle name="Source" checked={true} />
          <ColumnToggle name="Created" checked={true} sortDir="desc" />
          <ColumnToggle name="Updated" checked={true} />
          <ColumnToggle name="Inactive" checked={false} />
        </ColumnToggleList>
      </ColumnPickerPopover>

      <PeopleTable>
        <TableHeader>
          <Col field="name" label="Name" />
          <Col field="created" label="Created" sortDir="desc" />
          <Col field="last_visit" label="Last Visit" />
          <Col field="last_communication" label="Last Communication" />
          <Col field="last_text_received" label="Last Text Received" />
          {/* phone column visible in right portion */}
          <Col field="phone" label="Phone" />
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {people.map(person => (
            <PersonRow key={person.id}>
              <NameCell>
                <Avatar initials={person.initials} colorHash={person.id} />
                <PersonName>{person.name}</PersonName>
                {person.tags.map(tag => <TagPill>{tag}</TagPill>)}
              </NameCell>
              <DateCell>{person.created}</DateCell>
              <DateCell>{person.lastVisit}</DateCell>
              <CommunicationCell>
                {person.lastComm && (
                  <>
                    <RelativeTime>{person.lastComm.relativeTime}</RelativeTime>
                    <Snippet>{person.lastComm.snippet}</Snippet>
                  </>
                )}
              </CommunicationCell>
              <DateCell>{person.lastTextReceived}</DateCell>
              <PhoneCell>
                {person.phone && (
                  <>
                    <PhoneStatusIcon status={person.phoneStatus} />
                    {person.twilioEnabled && <TwilioIcon />}
                    <PhoneNumber>{person.phone}</PhoneNumber>
                  </>
                )}
              </PhoneCell>
            </PersonRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
      </PeopleTable>
    </ContentArea>

    <FilterPanel open={true}>
      <AddFilterSearch placeholder="Add a filter" />
      <FilterList>
        <FilterRow label="Tags exclude any of: complianc..." expandable />
        <FilterRow label="Last Communication more than..." expandable />
        <FilterRow label="Stage excludes any of: Active C..." expandable />
        <FilterRow label="Phone is good" expandable />
        <FilterRow label="Tags exclude any of: Unsubscri..." expandable />
        <FilterRow label="Agent includes any of: Matt Ryan" expandable />
        <FilterRow label="Tags include any of: Expired, wi..." expandable />
      </FilterList>
      <ClearFiltersLink label="Clear filters" />
    </FilterPanel>
  </BodyLayout>
</PeoplePage>
```

### Non-Obvious Logic

1. **Smart list badge vs. "Showing N people" discrepancy:** The left rail badge (e.g., 477) represents ALL contacts matching the smart list's saved definition. The "Showing 24 people" in the header reflects the table after additionally applying runtime session filters (e.g., via the right filter panel). The smart list badge does NOT update when runtime filters are applied — it always reflects the saved list total.

2. **"Update List" saves vs. runtime filters:** The right filter panel's filters are initially the smart list's saved criteria, but can be temporarily modified in-session. "Update List" commits those session changes back to the smart list definition permanently. "Clear filters" only clears the session overrides, not the saved definition.

3. **Column preset dropdown ("Out Of State Home ..."):** This is a saved named set of column visibility/order configurations, separate from the smart list itself. One smart list can have multiple column presets.

4. **Phone status icons:** Two distinct icons appear per phone cell:
   - Green circle with handset = "phone is good" (verified, dialable, not on DNC). This corresponds exactly to the active filter "Phone is good" on this list.
   - Purple circle = may indicate Twilio messaging capability, or that a text has been sent via Twilio to this number, or possibly a "ringless voicemail" status. Not all contacts show the purple icon.

5. **Last Communication snippet:** This cell shows the content preview of the most recent outbound or inbound communication (call note, email, text). The relative timestamp ("7 months ago") is dynamic, calculated from current date. The snippet is truncated with "..." and clicking likely opens the communication in the timeline.

6. **Column category counts:** The numbers in parentheses next to each category (e.g., "Details (10)") count the total number of available columns in that category, NOT the number currently visible/checked. This helps users find columns.

7. **Tag pills in the Name column:** Tags are surfaced inline under the person's name in the Name cell rather than in a separate column, even though "Tags" is a separately checkable column. The Tags column may show all tags; the Name cell may show a subset (first 1–2). [INFERRED]

8. **URL structure:** `/2/people/list/37` — the `2` is the account/workspace ID, `people/list` is the list view route, `37` is the smart list ID. This is different from `/2/people/<personId>` for individual records.

9. **"Showing 24 people"** vs. full count: The combination of 7 runtime filters reduces 477 → 24. Each filter is additive (AND logic). The filter criteria are all exclusionary except "Tags include any of: Expired" and "Phone is good" which are inclusionary.

10. **Columns picker opens as a popover (not a side panel or modal):** It floats over the table content, positioned below the "Columns" toolbar button, and stays open while the user interacts with it. Clicking outside dismisses it.
